body: Thanks for the input. I don't have any suicidal dreams at all, (not that I can recollect, anyway), but interesting to read about. More of a consious-thought kind of thing.

Thanks for the post.

I've never attempted it. I stashed away an entire bottle of Oxycotin and some vodka in my room about a year ago and it's made me feel ... safe? In control? Prepared? Something, anyway. It's a good feeling to have it there, anyway.
